translation.entry: Propaganda 2 is a 6 row, 6 column cluster game with increasing global multiplier, dropping symbols, and feature activations.
The game view displays the player balance, bet level, and win amount. All values remain visible throughout the session in both landscape and portrait orientations.

The game is a cluster paying game. A winning cluster consists of 5 or more identical symbols connected vertically or horizontally. For each symbol type, only the largest winning cluster is paid in each win evaluation. The RTP is the same throughout the game and the RTP is defined in the game rules.

3 or more Bonus symbols trigger the Bonus game with Bonus drops. If at least one Bonus symbol is a Super Bonus symbol, the Super Bonus game is awarded. In the Super Bonus all features are activated.
The Mask symbol is collected when a winning cluster is adjacent to a Mask symbol. Collecting 6 Mask symbols triggers the Drop Bonus game. The Drop Bonus game plays with 3 spins. Landing one or more symbols resets the spin counter to 3.

3 Bonus symbols trigger the Bonus game with 7 Bonus drops.
If a Super Bonus symbol appears during the Bonus game, the game upgrades to the Super Bonus game and 2 additional Bonus drops are awarded.
A Mask symbol activates when adjacent to a winning cluster. Collecting 6 Mask symbols triggers the Drop Bonus.
A Wild Strike feature symbol activates when adjacent to a winning cluster. It adds 2, 3, 4, or 5 Wild symbols to the grid and then becomes a Wild symbol.
A Heart feature symbol activates when adjacent to a winning cluster. The Heart symbol then becomes the selected payout symbol type.
The Upgrade symbol upgrades all payout symbols to a higher payout symbol type on the game grid and then becomes the payout symbol type.
The Collect symbol selects a symbol area on the grid, gathers all symbols within the selected area into a single cluster, and then becomes the payout symbol type.
In the Bonus game, the Add Bonus Drop symbol awards 1 additional Bonus drop.

Propaganda 2 is a 6 row, 6 column cluster game with increasing global multiplier, dropping symbols, and feature activations.
The minimum bet is __MINBADEFBMODE__, the maximum bet is __MAXBADEFBMODE__.
Each bet is __CPBB__ coins.
A winning cluster consists of 5 or more identical symbols connected vertically or horizontally. Only the largest cluster of each symbol type is paid.
A game round starts when the player presses the Spin button.
The game can be played automatically using Auto Spin. Hold the Spin button or use the Auto Spin menu to set the number of rounds.
Winnings and winning combinations are paid according to the Paytable.
Winnings are shown in the player's currency or in coins. This can be changed in Settings.
Winnings are shown in the player's currency.
The game is played in two modes: base game and Bonus mode.

Wild symbols substitute for all payout symbols. They do not substitute for Bonus symbols, Bonus Drop symbols, Super Bonus symbols, or feature symbols. A cluster consisting only of Wild symbols pays as the highest-paying symbol.

Each round begins with a symbol drop filling the grid. Winning symbols are removed, the remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position, and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The Avalanche continues as long as new winning combinations appear.

The global multiplier applies to all winning clusters. Each winning symbol increases the global multiplier by 1. The global multiplier is reset when entering the Bonus game and remains active between Bonus drops.
Each winning cluster generates a Wild symbol that appears in one of the empty spaces created after the explosion of the winning symbols.

The multiplier values of the Wild symbols are added together and applied to the generated Wild symbol, if several Wild symbols contribute to the same winning cluster. Normal Wild symbols are counted as having a multiplier value of 1.
The Wild Strike feature symbol activates when adjacent to a winning cluster.
The Wild Strike feature adds 2, 3, 4 or 5 Wild symbols onto the grid.
After activation, the Wild Strike feature symbol becomes a Wild symbol.
The Heart feature activates when the Heart symbol is adjacent to a winning cluster.
When winning symbols are removed and all empty symbol positions are filled, the Heart feature selects 1 or more payout symbol types and transforms all of them into one payout symbol type.
After activation, the Heart feature symbol becomes the selected payout symbol type.
The Mask symbols are activated when the Mask symbol is adjacent to a winning cluster.
Activated Masks symbols are collected at the end of the game round and added to the mask symbol inventory.
Collecting 6 Mask symbols triggers the Drop Bonus game.
The number of collected Masks symbols is kept between game rounds.
Mask symbols cannot land during Bonus drops.
Mask symbols have a different probability of landing depending on how many Mask symbols have been collected.
The Love Bomb feature can trigger in any base game drop or Bonus drop. Energy attached to feature symbols is added to the Love Bomb energy at the end of a game round.

The energy of the Love Bomb is kept between game rounds. When triggered, the Love Bomb feature activates all feature symbols during a game round or a Bonus drop. Every game round has the same probability of triggering the Love Bomb feature.
3 Bonus symbols trigger the Bonus game with 7 Bonus drops.
In the Bonus game, the Add Bonus Drop symbol awards 1 additional Bonus drop.
If a Super Bonus symbol appears during the Bonus game, the game upgrades to the Super Bonus game and 2 additional Bonus drops are awarded.
The Bonus game ends when no Bonus drops remain, or when the win cap is reached.
The Bonus game ends when no Bonus drops remain.
The Super Bonus game is triggered when at least one of the Bonus symbols that trigger the Bonus game is a Super Bonus symbol.
In the Super Bonus game, all feature symbols are activated.
The Super Bonus game ends when no Bonus drops remain, or when the win cap is reached.
The Super Bonus game ends when no Bonus drops remain.
The Drop Bonus plays with payout symbols, Wild symbols, Collect symbols and Upgrade symbols.
3 spins are awarded in the Drop Bonus. Landing one or more symbols during the Drop Bonus resets the spin counter to 3.
All symbols remain on the grid between spins during the Drop Bonus game. The total value of all cluster wins on the game grid is paid out when the Drop Bonus ends.
The Upgrade symbol upgrades all payout symbols to a higher payout symbol type on the game grid and then becomes the payout symbol type.
The Collect symbol selects a symbol area on the grid, gathers all symbols within the selected area into a single cluster, and then becomes the payout symbol type.
Wild symbols add their multiplier value to their respective cluster. If more than 1 Wild symbol contributes to the same cluster, their multiplier values are added together and applied to the cluster.
The Drop Bonus ends when there are no spins remaining or when the win cap is reached.
The Drop Bonus ends when no spins remain.
After the Drop Bonus ends there is a chance to get 1, 2 or 3 mask symbols added to the mask inventory.
Winnings are paid at the end of the game round.
The maximum total win is capped at __TBB__ the placed bet.
The probability to hit the maximum win is __MWP__.
The game will be capped at __TBB__ the placed bet.
A game round is immediately ended when the win cap is reached, and the wins collected so far will be paid out.
No bets can be changed during a game round.
The theoretical payout (RTP) is __RTP__.
In the event of malfunction, all bets and wins are void.

The X-iter feature offers buy-in to different game modes.
SUPER BONUS: Guarantees entry to the Super Bonus game with 7 Bonus drops at the cost of __X05_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
BONUS GAME: Guarantees entry to the Bonus game with 7 Bonus drops at the cost of __X04_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
LOVE BOMB: Guarantees Love Bomb feature on the first drop at the cost of __X03_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
MEGA HUNT: Greatly increases the chance to trigger the Bonus game at the cost of __X02_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
BONUS HUNT: Increases the chance to trigger the Bonus game at the cost of __X01_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
X-iter modes are purchased by selecting the mode and pressing Spin.
X-iter modes can only be activated in the base game.
The theoretical payout (RTP) for all X-iter modes is __RTP__.
The minimum X-iter cost is __MINBABMODE__, the maximum X-iter cost is __MAXBABMODE__.
